scope: New Node-only public Vault income client, mandatory caller journal contract, separate bounded public HTTP transport and independent read-only raw-transaction reader. No existing main, payment service or native adapter was edited by this SDK increment.

finalWindows.execution: Three separate focused commands, not one combined final batch.

acceptance: Actual startPilot intake, actual Selection/Vault/token deployments and external EIP3009 payer signatures on disposable Anvil.
Mandatory separate disk caller journal: unsigned/signed persistence before exposure/POST, orderly close/reopen, lost HTTP response plus main restart, exact header retry and one canonical debit.
Actual 202 confirmation wait, independently verified raw hash/facilitator/calldata and canonical fee classification, original candidate retained.
Actual reorg withdraws success; one and two formerly settled payments recover only original hashes without cross-attempt exact-retry deadlock.
Wrong payer/signature, substituted hash/calldata, strict malformed HTTP bounds, callback persistence failure, concurrent-call refusal and retained journal capacity.
Reused untrusted challenge or nonce is rejected before save without poisoning retained evidence.
Actual outer low-gas revert remains unresolved while its bearer authorization is valid; new authorization requires canonical confirmed expiry and fresh unused-marker inspection.
Independent receipt conservation and client ref/fee/net consistency; later token or alternate Vault consumption after reverted transaction fails reconciliation.
Current and receipt-block token/Selection/implementation/clone checks, expiry/freeze/Death historical preservation, EIP1898 canonical anchors, lost depth, unsupported raw RPC and safe error handling.

review.independentReadOnlyReview: Root and sibling reviewers inspected the final client/HTTP/journal flow and independent reader. No remaining actionable findings reported.
corrections: Duplicate untrusted offer poison prevented before persistence.
Unsigned/signed check states distinguish planned, authorized and submitted.
Exact previously submitted retries remain available after a multi-payment reorg.
Still-valid reverted authorization is not treated as cancelled.
Missing-reader asynchronous failures are sanitized and latest consumption pins fresh asset plus deployment.
Canonical reverted receipts are rechecked for later authorization/ref consumption; the native counterpart was fixed separately by root in the baseline.

history.note: The real streamed-response case exposed a deadline/cancel ordering bug: cancellation could mask timeout as invalid JSON. The deadline is now rejected before cancellation.

The timeout assertion passed; the remaining fixture failure observed the asynchronous server response-close event too early. The fixture now awaits the precise event without weakening the timeout or cleanup assertion.
Initial ten actual-main scenarios passed before the two-payment reorg, custom-reader arithmetic and still-valid reverted authorization additions.
Focused delta: both formerly settled payments became pending under one actual Anvil reorg and recovered exact original hashes. Ten other cases were filtered, not executed.
Twelve actual-main cases plus eighteen HTTP cases passed. The subsequent still-valid reverted bearer guard and thirteenth actual-main case are covered by the final13 report.

Five initial fixture failures: owner had no remaining tokens after entry, and historical-code proxy vectors assumed params on eth_blockNumber. Fixtures were corrected; intended override counts are now asserted.
Focused fixture-diagnostic acceptance only; filtered cases were not executed.
Twenty-five reader cases passed before the final fresh latest-consumption deployment-anchor consistency gate.

limitations: A production durable/exclusive journal remains a caller implementation obligation. No in-memory default or production file adapter is provided.
The acceptance-only disk fixture proves orderly process reopen, not power-loss durability, production ACL policy or stale-lock recovery.
Custom readers are trusted evidence boundaries; the concrete reader requires raw signed transaction RPC and fails closed without reconstruction fallback.
The first durably recorded candidate is immutable. A volatile hash cannot survive a failed journal save and crash.
No public network/profile, deployment, personal wallet, provider payment or service-execution integration was enabled or tested.
Linux acceptance is pending and is not implied by these Windows results; historical main190 reports remain pinned to their earlier source.

linux.plannedCommands: Full normal build followed by final native52 plus SDK56 (108 focused cases) on a fresh immutable source snapshot.
